parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, typically small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the pump tube and outlet nozzle, made of plastic for lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle, ensuring smooth flow during dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but supports the vertical motion of the pressing lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, typically cylindrical and made of ceramic for stability and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main housing for the liquid contents.
